                amounts AS (SELECT month_label, SUM(net_cents)::BIGINT net_cents, SUM(units_sold)::BIGINT units_sold, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)::BIGINT orders FROM joined_sales WHERE sale_date>=?::DATE AND sale_date<?::DATE AND market IN (?,?,?,?,?)
